name: Resonance
description: Véritable nexus de données vivant, Resonance fait résonner les données vivantes, maîtrise le hacking mélodique.

subject.archetype: Synthetic Chronometer assault fighter - Cyber-ascetic android monk with no facial features, smooth metallic plate visage, humanoid silhouette cloaked in worn monastic attire

loadout.armor_outfit: Thick synthetic fiber monk robes with braided cable strands, aged patina ceramic plating integrated into fabric, metallic shoulder pauldrons etched with dormant runic patterns, holographic golden mantra circles orbiting torso
loadout.arsenal: Electrified pilgrim's staff with crackling arc discharges along shaft, binary equation projections manifesting during attacks, ceremonial prayer wheel combat tool mounted on forearm

attitude.behavior: Charging assault fighter lunging into enemy ranks with explosive momentum, combat stance lowered with staff raised and crackling with energy, body coiled like compressed spring, mid-stride attack position
attitude.emotion: Cold lethal focus emanating from smooth featureless visor, calculating temporal awareness, aggressive synchronized assault intent

palette_names.name: Steel patina
palette_names.role: primary body armor and staff metal

palette_names.name: Holographic gold
palette_names.role: floating runic symbols and mantra projections

palette_names.name: Electric pale gold
palette_names.role: staff energy arcs and harmonic shockwaves

palette_names.name: Matte black
palette_names.role: cable braids and secondary mechanical elements

color_and_light.mood: Aggressive meditative fury, synchronized destruction, serene lethal precision

camera.angle: low_dutch_angle_emphasizing_forward_momentum, slight upward tilt to highlight floating holographic runes

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater battlefield, massive cracked crystal formations erupting outward from harmonic overload, concentric shockwave rings tearing through enemy positions, fragments raining from resonating fractured ceiling mandalas, every surface vibrating creating visible air distortion ripples
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Harmonic frequency vibration distortion making air appear to ripple and waver, golden binary equation projections cascading through air, crystal shard debris suspended mid-explosion, resonance shockwave rings expanding outward from character's position, particle dust floating in oscillating air currents
